pages.text: The Catapult and Trebuchet use $(item)Stone$() blocks as ammunition. Simply load cobblestone or stone into the machine's inventory.$(br2)$(l)Tip:$() The Trebuchet can also use $(item)Giant Stones$() for even more devastating impacts!

pages.title: Giant Stone
pages.text: $(item)Giant Stones$() deal massive damage and have a larger blast radius. Perfect for taking down structures and groups of enemies.
